en.tldr: Amazon S3 can serve static webpages, including pages with client-side scripts. Choose S3 website hosting when an HTTP website is sufficient; for HTTPS with private S3 content, use CloudFront with an S3 bucket origin and origin access control (OAC).
whenToUse: A site consists of static files and does not need server-side application processing.
An HTTP-only site can be served directly from an S3 website endpoint.
Visitors need HTTPS while the S3 bucket remains private.
S3 content uses SSE-KMS and must be served through CloudFront.
keyFacts: S3 static website hosting supports an index document and a custom error document.
An S3 website endpoint does not provide HTTPS.
CloudFront can serve static content stored in S3 over HTTPS.
For an SSE-KMS-encrypted S3 website served through CloudFront, use OAC; origin access identity (OAI) does not support SSE-KMS.
AWS recommends Amplify Hosting for a fully managed deployment of static S3 content to a CloudFront-powered CDN with a public HTTPS URL.
gotchas: Do not choose a direct S3 website endpoint when visitors require HTTPS.
Do not treat an S3 website endpoint as the private S3 bucket origin protected by CloudFront OAC.
For SSE-KMS content, replacing OAC with OAI does not meet the encryption requirement.

confusedWith.difference: Amplify manages deployment to a CloudFront-powered CDN and provides a public HTTPS URL; direct S3 website hosting does not provide HTTPS.
For an S3 origin with SSE-KMS-encrypted objects, use OAC rather than OAI.

examCues: HTTPS with a private S3 bucket

es.tldr: Amazon S3 puede servir páginas estáticas, incluso con scripts del lado del cliente. Elige S3 website hosting si basta HTTP; para HTTPS con contenido privado en S3, usa CloudFront con un origen de bucket S3 y origin access control (OAC).
whenToUse: El sitio contiene archivos estáticos y no necesita procesamiento de aplicaciones en el servidor.
Un sitio solo HTTP puede servirse directamente desde un S3 website endpoint.
Los visitantes necesitan HTTPS y el bucket S3 debe permanecer privado.
El contenido de S3 usa SSE-KMS y debe servirse mediante CloudFront.
keyFacts: S3 static website hosting admite un documento de índice y un documento de error personalizado.
Un S3 website endpoint no proporciona HTTPS.
CloudFront puede servir contenido estático almacenado en S3 mediante HTTPS.
Para un sitio en S3 cifrado con SSE-KMS y servido mediante CloudFront, usa OAC; origin access identity (OAI) no admite SSE-KMS.
AWS recomienda Amplify Hosting para implementar contenido estático de S3 en un CDN administrado basado en CloudFront, con una URL pública HTTPS.
gotchas: No elijas un S3 website endpoint directo si los visitantes necesitan HTTPS.
No confundas un S3 website endpoint con un origen de bucket S3 privado protegido mediante CloudFront OAC.
Para contenido SSE-KMS, sustituir OAC por OAI no cumple el requisito de cifrado.

confusedWith.difference: Amplify administra la implementación en un CDN basado en CloudFront y proporciona una URL pública HTTPS; S3 website hosting directo no proporciona HTTPS.
Para un origen S3 con objetos cifrados mediante SSE-KMS, usa OAC en lugar de OAI.

examCues: HTTPS with a private S3 bucket

questions.stem: A neighborhood association publishes meeting notes as HTML pages with a small amount of client-side JavaScript. Its existing link uses HTTP, HTTPS is not required, and the association does not need a CDN. Which solution serves the site with the LEAST configuration?

options.text: Create a CloudFront distribution that uses the S3 website endpoint as its origin.
options.why: The CloudFront distribution adds configuration despite the stated lack of a CDN requirement.

options.text: Deploy the files through AWS Amplify Hosting to its managed CDN.
options.why: Amplify adds a managed CDN deployment that the association does not need.

options.text: Enable static website hosting on an S3 bucket and configure an index document.
options.why: S3 website hosting directly serves the static files and supports an index document.

options.text: Create a CloudFront distribution with an S3 bucket origin and OAC.
options.why: CloudFront and OAC add configuration when neither HTTPS nor private-origin access is required.

questions.explanation: The pages are static, HTTP is acceptable, and the association does not need a CDN. S3 static website hosting can serve the files directly, with an index document for the site's entry page. Amplify Hosting and both CloudFront designs introduce a CDN that this scenario does not call for.
keywordCues: HTML pages with a small amount of client-side JavaScript

es.stem: Una asociación vecinal publica actas como páginas HTML con un poco de JavaScript del lado del cliente. Su enlace actual usa HTTP, no se requiere HTTPS y la asociación no necesita un CDN. ¿Qué solución sirve el sitio con la LEAST configuration?

options.text: Crear una distribución de CloudFront que use el S3 website endpoint como origen.
options.why: La distribución de CloudFront agrega configuración pese a que no se necesita un CDN.

options.text: Implementar los archivos mediante AWS Amplify Hosting en su CDN administrado.
options.why: Amplify agrega una implementación en un CDN administrado que la asociación no necesita.

options.text: Habilitar static website hosting en un bucket S3 y configurar un documento de índice.
options.why: S3 website hosting sirve directamente los archivos estáticos y admite un documento de índice.

options.text: Crear una distribución de CloudFront con un origen de bucket S3 y OAC.
options.why: CloudFront y OAC agregan configuración cuando no se requiere HTTPS ni acceso privado al origen.

es.explanation: Las páginas son estáticas, HTTP es aceptable y la asociación no necesita un CDN. S3 static website hosting puede servir los archivos directamente y usar un documento de índice para la página inicial. Amplify Hosting y ambas opciones de CloudFront agregan un CDN que este caso no requiere.

questions.stem: A research nonprofit stores its static publication site in an S3 bucket and requires SSE-KMS encryption for the files. Visitors must use HTTPS, and the bucket must not grant anonymous public access. Which design meets these requirements?

options.text: Enable S3 website hosting and grant public read access to the encrypted files.
options.why: A direct website endpoint does not provide HTTPS, and public read access violates the bucket requirement.

options.text: Use a CloudFront distribution with an S3 bucket origin and OAI.
options.why: OAI does not support the required SSE-KMS-encrypted origin content.

options.text: Put CloudFront in front of the S3 website endpoint and allow public access to the bucket.
options.why: Although CloudFront can provide HTTPS to visitors, this design leaves the bucket publicly accessible.

options.text: Use a CloudFront distribution with an S3 bucket origin and OAC.
options.why: CloudFront provides the HTTPS entry point, while OAC supports securing an S3 origin with SSE-KMS content.

questions.explanation: The deciding constraints are HTTPS, a bucket without anonymous public access, and SSE-KMS-encrypted files. CloudFront with an S3 bucket origin and OAC addresses those constraints. A direct S3 website endpoint cannot provide HTTPS, and a public website origin fails the access requirement. OAI is also unsuitable because it does not support SSE-KMS.
keywordCues: must not grant anonymous public access

es.stem: Una organización de investigación guarda su sitio estático de publicaciones en un bucket S3 y exige cifrado SSE-KMS para los archivos. Los visitantes deben usar HTTPS y el bucket no debe permitir acceso público anónimo. ¿Qué diseño cumple estos requisitos?

options.text: Habilitar S3 website hosting y conceder acceso público de lectura a los archivos cifrados.
options.why: Un website endpoint directo no proporciona HTTPS y el acceso público de lectura incumple el requisito del bucket.

options.text: Usar una distribución de CloudFront con un origen de bucket S3 y OAI.
options.why: OAI no admite el contenido cifrado mediante SSE-KMS que se requiere en el origen.

options.text: Colocar CloudFront delante del S3 website endpoint y permitir acceso público al bucket.
options.why: Aunque CloudFront puede proporcionar HTTPS a los visitantes, este diseño deja el bucket accesible públicamente.

options.text: Usar una distribución de CloudFront con un origen de bucket S3 y OAC.
options.why: CloudFront proporciona el acceso mediante HTTPS y OAC permite proteger un origen S3 con contenido SSE-KMS.

es.explanation: Los requisitos decisivos son HTTPS, un bucket sin acceso público anónimo y archivos cifrados mediante SSE-KMS. CloudFront con un origen de bucket S3 y OAC cumple esas condiciones. Un S3 website endpoint directo no proporciona HTTPS y un origen de sitio web público incumple el requisito de acceso. OAI tampoco sirve porque no admite SSE-KMS.

questions.stem: A small publisher keeps a set of static articles in an S3 bucket. The team wants to deploy the articles to a globally available CDN and receive a public HTTPS URL, but does not want to configure the CDN distribution itself. Which solution meets these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.text: Enable S3 static website hosting and distribute its website endpoint URL.
options.why: The S3 website endpoint does not provide the required HTTPS URL or CDN deployment.

options.text: Configure a CloudFront distribution with the S3 website endpoint as its origin.
options.why: This also requires the team to configure the CDN distribution itself.

options.text: Configure a CloudFront distribution with the S3 bucket as its origin.
options.why: This requires the team to configure the CDN distribution itself.

options.text: Deploy the S3 content with AWS Amplify Hosting.
options.why: Amplify provides managed deployment to a CloudFront-powered CDN and a public HTTPS URL.

questions.explanation: The publisher wants a managed CDN deployment, a public HTTPS URL, and minimal distribution configuration. Amplify Hosting deploys static content from S3 to a managed CloudFront-powered CDN and supplies an HTTPS URL. Direct S3 website hosting misses HTTPS and the CDN. Either self-configured CloudFront option misses the stated operational-overhead preference.
keywordCues: does not want to configure the CDN distribution itself

es.stem: Una editorial pequeña guarda artículos estáticos en un bucket S3. El equipo quiere implementarlos en un CDN disponible globalmente y obtener una URL pública HTTPS, pero no quiere configurar la distribución del CDN por su cuenta. ¿Qué solución cumple los requisitos con la LEAST operational overhead?

options.text: Habilitar S3 static website hosting y compartir la URL de su website endpoint.
options.why: El S3 website endpoint no proporciona la URL HTTPS ni la implementación en un CDN que se requieren.

options.text: Configurar una distribución de CloudFront con el S3 website endpoint como origen.
options.why: Esta opción también exige que el equipo configure la distribución del CDN por su cuenta.

options.text: Configurar una distribución de CloudFront con el bucket S3 como origen.
options.why: Esta opción exige que el equipo configure la distribución del CDN por su cuenta.

options.text: Implementar el contenido de S3 con AWS Amplify Hosting.
options.why: Amplify ofrece una implementación administrada en un CDN basado en CloudFront y una URL pública HTTPS.

es.explanation: La editorial quiere una implementación administrada en un CDN, una URL pública HTTPS y mínima configuración de la distribución. Amplify Hosting implementa contenido estático de S3 en un CDN administrado basado en CloudFront y proporciona una URL HTTPS. S3 website hosting directo no aporta HTTPS ni el CDN. Ambas opciones de CloudFront configuradas por el equipo incumplen la preferencia de reducir la carga operativa.

recall.prompt: A static S3 site needs HTTPS, a private bucket, and SSE-KMS encryption. What origin and access-control design would you choose, and why?
recall.promptEs: Un sitio estático en S3 necesita HTTPS, un bucket privado y cifrado SSE-KMS. ¿Qué origen y mecanismo de control de acceso elegirías, y por qué?
recall.idealAnswer: Use CloudFront with an S3 bucket origin and OAC. CloudFront serves visitors over HTTPS, and OAC supports securing an S3 origin whose content uses SSE-KMS; OAI does not support SSE-KMS.
rubric: Names CloudFront as the HTTPS entry point.
Specifies an S3 bucket origin rather than an S3 website endpoint.
Chooses OAC and explains that OAI does not support SSE-KMS.
